title: Natural Sciences Skeleton v1
description: Coverage skeleton for the natural-sciences continent (fourth continent, CPO-selected 2026-06-11, vault decision log (29)): field/subfield two-level node set under domain:natural-sciences — physical, chemical, astronomical and earth/environmental sciences — each tagged with academic_status. Construction input only — not canonical graph data; nodes only, zero edges (skeleton-first). The two junction nodes already canonical in /data (domain:natural-sciences, field:physics) are out of generation scope. Biology-family areas (LCC QH-QR, UDC 57-59, FORD 1.6) belong to the life-sciences continent and are out of scope entirely.

include: Natural sciences field and subfield coverage skeleton (nodes only)
Physics areas under LCC QC and UDC 53, with the PhySH discipline scheme as the continent's discipline-specific granularity reference for physics subfields
Chemistry areas under LCC QD and UDC 54, FORD 1.4
Astronomy and astrophysics areas under LCC QB and UDC 52, FORD 1.3
Earth and environmental science areas under LCC QE (plus the QC801-999 geophysics/meteorology ranges) and UDC 55-56 plus 502/504, FORD 1.5
Wikidata QID resolution for identity and external_ids
exclude: Edges and relations (skeleton-first: dots before lines; part_of skeleton edges are a separate batch)
Re-proposing any existing /data node (domain:natural-sciences, field:physics, and all 153 other canonical nodes; reconcile to existing IDs instead)

Biology-family areas (LCC QH-QR, UDC 57-59, FORD 1.6): biology, botany, zoology, microbiology, physiology, ecology, genetics — life-sciences continent (bioinformatics precedent, section-12 ruling 2026-06-11)
Mathematics (UDC 51 sits inside UDC 5 but the formal-sciences continent already covers it — no duplicate generation; section-12 pre-registered ruling)
Computer and information sciences (FORD 1.2 files CIS under natural sciences; the existing separate domain stands — section-12 pre-registered ruling)
Existing formal-sciences boundary nodes (mathematical-physics stays under formal sciences; its physics-side second membership is a separate cross-listing task under section 13)
subfield:quantum-computing (already canonical under CS with a natural-sciences membership; any quantum-information-science candidate must reconcile against it, not duplicate it)

allowed_public_sources.notes: CC0. Resolver verifies the unverified training-knowledge QID hints in the proposal and fills missing QIDs.
External-link / source-resolution pointer only. Never store or cache article bodies.

forbidden_sources.reason: NamuWiki is external-link-only and must never be used as evidence or a source, nor have its content cached.
No cloud LLM API calls are permitted in repo tooling, build, validation, or runtime.
Scraping or crawling third-party article bodies is forbidden; only open, license-compatible data is allowed.

notes: Continent selection ratified by the CPO 2026-06-11 (vault decision log (29)).

Coverage baseline for generation/QC: LCC class Q outline (QB/QC/QD/QE; outline PDF + id.loc.gov authority records for cutter-level checks), UDC class 5 (52-56 plus 502/504 via the UDC Summary getrecord endpoint), OECD FORD section 1 (1.3/1.4/1.5/1.7; arrs.si mirror), and PhySH (physh.org, CC0, JSON API) ratified as the continent's discipline-specific granularity reference for physics subfields (ACM CCS precedent, section-12 source interpretation 2026-06-11) — its 18 disciplines are subfield-granularity references; its 461 concepts sit below skeleton granularity. MSC 2020 and the arXiv category taxonomy stay auxiliary cross-checks. All four baseline sources were live-captured by the orchestrator on 2026-06-11 before this manifest was written.
docs/data-foundry.md section 12 (including its precedent log) is a mandatory input to the generation order (promotion policy v1.3); section 13 governs any multi-membership question raised during QC.

Pre-registered structural questions for QC: (1) biology boundary — life-sciences domain key exists; bioinformatics-to-life-sciences precedent inherited; (2) no duplicate generation for mathematics (formal sciences) or CIS (existing domain) despite UDC 5/FORD 1 filings; (3) dual-filed boundary areas flagged per seed notes (atmospheric science, mineralogy, biochemistry, geodesy, oceanography, hydrology, geomorphology, environmental science level, biophysics, medical physics); (4) quantum-information-science must reconcile against the existing quantum-computing node; (5) post-skeleton re-target triggers recorded in the session order: quantum-computing's domain-direct membership edge re-targets to field:physics once the continent lands, and mathematical-physics's minority-side physics membership is a section-13 candidate.
/data remains the source of truth for accepted graph data.

Seeds regenerated mechanically from the QC-passed proposal.json (41 nodes, 2026-06-11) — formal-sciences/CS precedent (PR #30, session #8). Dropped at QC: medical-physics (deferred to medicine-and-health), polymer-chemistry and computational-chemistry (absorbed, v2 re-split candidates).
